rows.title: Measured survey, trade/shop drawings and samples
rows.note: Measured plans and cabinet/electrical coordination; no interior designer, design-build or furniture-procurement fee.

rows.title: Permit and trade documentation allowance
rows.note: Includes allowance for forming Bedroom 5. Actual jurisdictional fees and required documents must be confirmed.

rows.title: Protection, mobilization, dry-area waste and final clean
rows.note: Whole-house coordination and occupied-home protection. Floor removal is in flooring; kitchen/bath demolition is in those room packages.

rows.title: New natural engineered-oak flooring
rows.note: 3,000 net dry-area square feet assumed, not a measured takeoff. Includes material waste, ordinary removal, installation, transitions and routine substrate preparation. Excludes stair treads, wet-room floors and gym rubber.

rows.title: General warm matte paint, ceilings and trim
rows.note: Whole-house dry areas including Bedroom 5, doors and high gallery access; ordinary prep. Wet-room paint is in bath packages. No stripping hazardous coatings or major wall reconstruction.

rows.title: Selective Roman Clay / mineral finish upgrade
rows.note: 600 wall square feet assumed at an incremental $10–18/sf over general paint. Dry focal walls only; not every wall. Product and applicator sample unselected.

rows.title: Existing stair/rail finish coordination
rows.note: Refinish selected treads/rails and paint risers/balusters; retain existing structural stair geometry. No new stair fabrication.

rows.title: Dry-area wiring, light installation, LEDs and controls
rows.note: About 40 lighting/control points plus 100 ft of diffused LED used as planning scope, not a takeoff. Includes switches, drivers, cable concealment and access. Kitchen/bath/laundry wiring is in room packages; visible fixture purchases are separate. Bedroom 5 rough-in is in its shell package.

rows.title: Window-treatment installation
rows.note: Approximately 26 window/door treatment groups; manual tracks only. Fabric and track purchase is separate.

rows.title: Entrance gallery · fixed work
rows.note: Lettering, minor entry carpentry and mounting; cascade fixture purchase and electrical labor are shared allowances.

rows.title: Home office · fixed work
rows.note: Approximately 13 linear feet of full-height walnut-veneered fitted storage with mixed open/closed bays and compact printer cabinet. Desk/TV are purchases.

rows.title: Media room · fixed work
rows.note: Quiet TV backing, substantial walnut console and shallow display shelves by clear doors; AV cabling allowance included. No intense full slat wall.

rows.title: Studio gym · fixed work
rows.note: Approximately 155 sf resilient floor, safety-backed mirror and quote; existing closet remains. Empty room; no exercise equipment.

rows.title: Bath #3 · fixed work
rows.note: Compact full bathroom: demolition, waterproof shower, tile floor/walls, glass, vanity/top, plumbing fixtures, mirror, electrical and installation. Existing service positions.

rows.title: Great room · fixed work
rows.note: Fireplace surround substrate/trim work and TV mount/blocking. Mineral finish, electronics and freestanding consoles are separate. Existing fireplace retained.

rows.title: Kitchen · fixed work
rows.note: Replacement stock/semi-custom cabinet boxes with tailored warm-ivory fronts and walnut island, pale quartz/porcelain counters and backsplash, sink/faucet, demolition, trade connections and installation. Same layout. Appliances and pendants are separate.

rows.title: Formal dining · fixed work
rows.note: Shallow walnut wall shelf/cabinet under the high window, conditional on measured clearance. Table/chairs and freestanding sideboard are purchases.

rows.title: Living room · piano salon · fixed work
rows.note: Simple applied wall framing, substrate touchups and mounting. No structural changes or new ceiling.

rows.title: Owners suite · fixed work
rows.note: Walnut headwall band, floating bedside pieces and concealed-light support; new bed/dresser are purchases. LED wiring/drivers in shared electrical.

rows.title: Owners retreat · fixed work
rows.note: Replace small bar cabinetry, pale counter and sink/faucet, retaining services. Beverage fridge purchased separately.

rows.title: Owners bathroom · fixed work
rows.note: Full primary bath finishes: demo, waterproofing, porcelain tile, double vanity/top, tub, shower glass, fixtures and plumbing/electrical installation. Same fixture zones. No heated floor in base.

rows.title: Owners walk-in closet · fixed work
rows.note: Modular closet interiors with tailored trim/drawer fronts and assembly; no center island.

rows.title: Bedroom 2 · fixed work
rows.note: Simple wall framing/mounting and minor carpentry. Existing door location must be surveyed; no door relocation priced.

rows.title: Bedroom 3 · fixed work
rows.note: Simple wall treatment/mounting and minor carpentry; keep window and bed relationships.

rows.title: Shared bathroom · fixed work
rows.note: Shared bath with double vanity and separate wet area: replacement finishes, waterproofing, glass, fixtures and all trade installation. Existing service positions.

rows.title: Laundry · fixed work
rows.note: Replacement utility cabinets, folding counter, sink, floor tile, graphic/quote and appliance/service connection. Washer/dryer purchased separately.

rows.title: Penthouse lounge · fixed work
rows.note: Walnut wet-bar cabinetry, counter, sink and connections plus minor trim. Existing tray retained. Fridge and movable console purchased separately.

rows.title: Penthouse guest bedroom · fixed work
rows.note: NEW room: non-load-bearing partitions, drywall, sound insulation allowance, door/trim, basic closet enclosure, electrical/alarm work and modest HVAC distribution changes inside existing conditioned penthouse. Shared paint/flooring and permit allowance are separate. No exterior expansion or new roof/window opening.

rows.title: Penthouse bathroom · fixed work
rows.note: Replace compact guest-bath finishes and fixtures in an assumed existing serviced enclosure. If the bathroom shell/services also need building, obtain a separate additional quote.

rows.title: Roof terrace · fixed work
rows.note: Surface clean/minor touchups and installation of freestanding furnishings/lights. Existing deck, waterproofing, pergola, rails and fireplace retained.

rows.title: Entrance gallery · furniture
rows.note: Small entry table and practical drop-zone storage.

rows.title: Home office · furniture

rows.title: Media room · furniture
rows.note: Deep Cloud-style modular sofa, ottomans and substantial rug. Retail comfort-level allowance; exact RH selection may exceed it.

rows.title: Great room · furniture

rows.title: Kitchen · furniture

rows.title: Formal dining · furniture

rows.title: Living room · piano salon · furniture

rows.title: Sunroom · furniture

rows.title: Owners retreat · furniture
rows.note: Two lounge chairs/chaise seats and small side table.

rows.title: Bedroom 2 · furniture
rows.note: New bed, mattress, bedside pieces, small desk/chair, storage, loose rug and linens.

rows.title: Penthouse guest bedroom · furniture
rows.note: New guest bed/mattress, walnut storage/bedside pieces, loose rug and linens.

rows.title: Roof terrace · furniture
rows.note: Outdoor dining set, lounge seating, small tables and weather-rated cushions.

rows.title: Decorative lighting and lamps
rows.note: Entry cascade, kitchen/dining/sunroom pendants, bathroom decorative lights, sconces and portable lamps across rooms. Electrical labor in construction; LED tape/drivers there too.

rows.title: Drapery, tracks and blackout layers
rows.note: 26 treatment groups assumed. Manual, ready-made or semi-custom ivory sheers; blackout/privacy in bedrooms and media. Includes hardware; installation separate. Motorization and fully bespoke workroom drapes excluded.

rows.title: Artwork, frames, plants and accessories
rows.note: House-wide allowance, including sibling great-room art, bedroom and bathroom art. These are not also in room furniture rows.

rows.title: Kitchen, laundry and two bar refrigerators
rows.note: New kitchen refrigerator, cooktop, hood, wall oven/microwave and dishwasher; washer/dryer and two small beverage refrigerators. Connections in construction.

rows.title: TVs, soundbars and compatible cinema audio
rows.note: 83-inch media display, great-room TV, 55-inch owner TV and office TV, plus soundbars and compatible rear/ceiling audio. Final cinema topology must be chosen before wiring. No whole-house audio system.

rows.title: New compact baby grand piano
rows.note: Dealer-quote allowance, not a verified model price. Specialist delivery/tuning covered by shared logistics. Confirm footprint and upper-floor delivery route.
